name: Back Office Helper
description: Analyzes accessible cases and prepares case-building plans through read-only Back Office MCP queries, using one engine for loans and account opening.

skills.name: Back Office case queries
skills.description: Find a person's assigned document sets and explain current outstanding requirements with evidence references.
examples: What documents is this person missing?
Which document sets are assigned to this person?

skills.name: Case analysis and building plans
skills.description: Analyze a pinned case or prepare its creation and evidence-completion handoff, keeping business subjects separate from staff reviewers. Does not mutate business records.
examples: Analyze the outstanding findings for this loan case.
Prepare an account-opening case for this subject with the right Document Set version.
